## R Package Checklist
<!-- Go over all the following points, and check off the ones that apply. -->

### Code Quality & Standards
- [ ] Code follows the style guide used by this repo (e.g., `{Air}`, `tidyverse`).
- [ ] Functions, arguments, and variables are clearly and intuitively named.
- [ ] No `library()` or `require()` calls inside functions (use `pkg::fun()` or add to `DESCRIPTION`).

### Documentation & Namespace
- [ ] Roxygen2 documentation has been updated / added for new or modified functions.
- [ ] `devtools::document()` has been run to update `NAMESPACE` and `.Rd` files.
- [ ] `NEWS.md` has been updated with a brief note about this change under the development version heading.

### Testing & Validation
- [ ] Unit tests (`{testthat}`) have been added or updated to cover these changes.
- [ ] `devtools::test()` passes locally with 0 errors or failures.
- [ ] `devtools::check()` passes locally with 0 errors, 0 warnings, and 0 notes.
